messages:
rachel: FYI I just saw an admin CSV export include rows from another org after I switched contexts quickly. Pretty bad for demos.

ben: whoa. can you repro and paste the request/response?

rachel: repro steps: 1) open console as org-gamma, 2) open Admin -> Exports for dataset A, 3) switch to org-delta in header fast, 4) click export. The downloaded CSV contained several org-gamma rows then corrected.

omar: got any network logs? headers?

rachel: snippet from devtools: 
GET /api/internal/exports?dataset=A 200 OK
request headers: {"x-org-id":"org-delta","x-route":"exports-v1","authorization":"Bearer ..."}
response body preview: {"rows":[{"org":"org-gamma","id":123}, ...],"cache_key":"exports:dataset:A:exports-v1"}

lin: that cache_key is the smoking gun. Looks like Redis blob keyed by route only.

infra-bot: note: similar route-only caching was warned in monthly infra review (quota/prefetch/rollouts).

ben: immediate plan: 1) change gateway to include x-org-id in cache key (quick flip via feature flag); 2) evict offending keys; 3) add console-side guard to drop mismatched payloads and show warning; 4) run telemetry backfill to find misattributed events.

omar: agree. Gateway change is low-risk and centralized. I can open PR to add org to cache key composition and add a metric cache_miss_org_mismatch.

lin: console guard: if payload.rows[0].org !== currentOrg then warn + discard. tiny patch. rachel can take.

rachel: I'll do the console guard PR. Also adding a small UX banner: "Export may include stale rows after a rapid org switch; please refresh" until fixed.

ops: we can evict keys now. suggested commands:
redis-cli --scan --pattern 'exports:dataset:*' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli del

ops: running eviction... ops done, ~220 keys removed.

infra-bot: created incident INC-2030, severity: medium. owners requested.

ben: telemetry: we need to identify any billing/usage events tied to wrong org. Omar, can you run a query for events where event.org != request_header.x_org_id in the last 6 hours?

omar: will do and produce CSV for finance. Also scheduling a short job to annotate suspect events with tag=cache-org-leak.

lin: tests: add integration test that sends alternating X-Org-Id headers to the exports endpoint and asserts responses are org-scoped. Also add unit test for cache key builder to include org and cache version.

ben: canary plan: staging -> 5% prod -> 25% -> 100%. watch metrics: per-org export counts, org-header-mismatch rate, and any sudden revenue attribution changes.

rachel: temporary mitigation for support: advise users to hard-refresh after switching orgs or open a new tab until the patch lands.

omar: I'll attach the gateway PR to INC-2030 and make the org-key feature flag default off; we can flip in canary.

ops: owners assigned on INC-2030: omar (gateway), rachel (console guard + banner), lin (tests), ben (coord telemetry & rollout), ops (eviction/backfill).

ben: good catch, rachel. let's post a short postmortem after we finish backfill to cover impact and long-term guardrails.

rachel: noted. will update thread as things move. :white_check_mark:
